items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update addresses multiple critical, high, and medium vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: BlockStrap: Magento and Adobe Commerce RCE
items.summary: This is a CVSS 10.0 flaw that gives unauthenticated attackers remote code execution, fixed in APSB26-153 but requiring a manual patch. New installations remain vulnerable.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This high-severity vulnerability is categorized as Incorrect Authorization (CWE-863) and was addressed in APSB26-153. Successful exploitation could lead to privilege escalation.

items.title: Cross-site Scripting (Stored XSS) vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This high-severity vulnerability is a Stored Cross-site Scripting (CWE-79) issue. It was resolved as part of the APSB26-153 security update.

items.title: Cross-site Scripting (Stored XSS) vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This high-severity vulnerability is a Stored Cross-site Scripting (CWE-79) issue. It was resolved as part of the APSB26-153 security update.

items.title: Improper Input Validation vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This high-severity vulnerability is an Improper Input Validation (CWE-20) issue. It was resolved as part of the APSB26-153 security update.

items.title: Cross-site Scripting (Stored XSS) vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This high-severity vulnerability is a Stored Cross-site Scripting (CWE-79) issue. It was resolved as part of the APSB26-153 security update.

items.title: Urgent Action Required Critical Security Update Available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This bulletin addresses a critical zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650), known as 'StyleSmuggler', that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code. Adobe is aware of active exploitation in the wild.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE
items.summary: Discovered by Sansec, this zero-day vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers remote code execution and has a CVSS score of 10.0. Attacks started on September 4th, and an emergency hotfix was released.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including an actively exploited critical incorrect authorization flaw. Successful exploitation could result in security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) allows unauthenticated privilege escalation and elevated access to sensitive resources, including customer account takeover. It has been added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

items.title: Cross-site Scripting (Stored XSS) vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This high-severity stored XSS vulnerability (CVSS 8.7) could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Cross-site Scripting (Stored XSS) vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This high-severity stored XSS vulnerability (CVSS 7.7) could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: This high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.6) could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.
